open_issues: SHAPE CHANGE the controller must handle: index.json emits `image_only_pages` as {journalName: [pageName, ...]} — a LIST. I emitted {journalName: {enPageName: cnPageName}} — a DICT — because a positional list of 18 Chinese strings silently mis-assigns if anything reorders, and every other payload in this pack is already an english-keyed map. If the collector expects a list it will fail loudly rather than scramble, which is the intended failure mode; conversion is one dict-comprehension.

Scene names and the 18 art page names are delivered as PLAIN Chinese with no bilingual English tail. PROJECT.md §3.4 scopes T-BILINGUAL to 怪物/装备/天赋/行星/表格 and scenes are not on that list, and the art captions (Jump, Climb, Skills, Gear) are common nouns, not 专有名词. But 4-常用脚本/qa/scan_missing_bilingual_tail.py puts BOTH `scenes` and `pages` in its 应双语桶, so that script will report 6 scene names and 18 page names. Deliberate, not an oversight — if the controller wants tails it is a one-line change in each of my two maps. (`regions` and `behaviors` are in that script's 应裸中文桶, and I did leave those bare.)

COVERAGE GAP in the wave, outside my unit: nothing in index.json owns the JournalEntry names or the non-image page names. Untranslated by anyone today: journal "Map Pins" + its 17 page names, journal "Hope's Last Day" + its page, journal "Starter Set Rules" + its page, journal "The Art of Alien - Starter Set", and the page "STARTER SET - HOW TO USE THIS MODULE Text". The 17 Map Pins page names are exactly the room-label chain I list in lock_lookups, so they cannot be skipped without breaking the pin↔page match.

The welcome journal name "STARTER SET - HOW TO USE THIS MODULE" is T-FROZEN with plain ASCII U+0020 spaces (init.js:11), unlike the corerules twin which uses six U+00A0. I did not touch it — it is not in my payload — but whoever ends up owning journal names must not normalise either one.

Three upstream spelling mismatches inside the room-label chain, resolved to ONE Chinese each: scene note "Assistant Managers Office" vs Map Pins page / HLD <h3> "Assistant Manager Office" -> 助理主管办公室; scene note + Map Pins page "Geological Managers Office" vs HLD <h3> "Geological Manager Office" -> 地质主管办公室; scene notes "Stairs" (L1) and "Stairway" (L2) both -> 楼梯, both pinning the single page "Stairway & Elevator" (suggest 楼梯与电梯).

Two different folders share the English name "Alien Evolved" (an Item folder and an Actor folder). Babele's folders block is name-keyed, so my single value 异形进化版 necessarily renames both. Correct here, but worth knowing it is not a 1:1 mapping.

The folder "Alien Evolved Starter Set" (Scene folder) IS translated (异形进化版新手包) while the identically-named Adventure and Scene are frozen English. Verified safe: starterset's live import graph is only init.js / update.js / ImportSelectedAssets.js — migratefolders.js (which does contain game.folders.getName) is not imported by anything, and update.js's updateAssets array is empty in 1.0.2.

"NPC's" -> "NPC" and "PC's" -> "PC" carry no CJK, so any "untranslated" heuristic will flag them. Deliberate: glossary_alien.json maps NPCs->NPC and peer ST-J03.cn.html already writes "PC 移动"/"NPC 移动".
